mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TRMA_USER_INFO a WHERE a.USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT a.USER_ID FROM TB_TRMA_USER_INFO a WHERE a.USER_NM = #{userNm} ORDER BY a.CREATE_DT
SELECT a.USER_PW FROM TB_TRMA_USER_INFO a WHERE a.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT b.REVIEW_ID ,b.REVIEW_TITLE ,b.REVIEW_CONTENT ,b.REVIEW_CONTENT_EN ,b.REVIEW_CONTENT_JA ,b.REVIEW_SCORE ,c.USER_NM ,c.PROFILE_IMG_URL ,b.IMG_URLS ,b.CREATE_DT FROM TB_TRMA_MOIM_REVIEW b LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_MOIM_LIST a ON a.MOIM_ID = b.MOIM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_USER_INFO c ON b.CREATE_USER = c.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND b.USE_YN = 'Y' AND b.REVIEW_TYPE_CD = 'O'
AND (a.CREATE_USER = #{userId} OR b.CREATE_USER = #{userId})
ORDER BY b.REVIEW_SCORE DESC, b.CREATE_DT DESC ORDER BY b.CREATE_DT DESC
LIMIT 10
OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_TRMA_USER_LANGUAGE (USER_ID, LANG_CD, LEVEL_CD, SORT_ORDER) VALUES (#{userId}, #{langCd}, #{levelCd}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT a.LANG_CD ,b.CMM_CM_NM AS LANG_NM ,a.LEVEL_CD AS LEVEL_NM FROM TB_TRMA_USER_LANGUAGE a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_CMM_CD_D b ON a.LANG_CD = b.CMM_CDV AND b.CMM_CD_ID = 'LANG_CD' WHERE a.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY a.SORT_ORDER
